search_space: The single labeled loopless simple undirected graph V={0,1,2,3,4}, E={{0,1},{1,2},{0,2},{0,3},{3,4},{0,4}}, with all 10 unordered pairs of distinct vertices checked in lexicographic order; every simple path for each pair was enumerated.
witness_description: The connected graph with vertices {0,1,2,3,4} and edges {0-1,1-2,0-2,0-3,3-4,0-4}, with the distinct vertices 1 and 3.
refutation_explanation: Every edge lies on one of the triangles 0-1-2-0 or 0-3-4-0, so deleting any edge does not increase the number of connected components; hence no edge is a bridge. Removing vertex 0 separates 1 from 3, so every path from 1 to 3 contains 0 as an internal vertex. Consequently, no two such paths are internally disjoint.
